A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. ​ On October 14, 2026, the Company also announced in a press release that its Board of Directors approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend to its shareholders. The quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share will be paid on December 1, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 11, 2026. Additionally, the Board of Directors approved the payment of a special dividend to its shareholders. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.2 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. ​ ​ ​ Item 8.01 Other Events ​ On October 14, 2026, the Company announced in a press release that its Board of Directors approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend to its shareholders. The quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share will be paid on December 1, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 11, 2026. Additionally, the Board of Directors approved the payment of a special dividend to its shareholders. The special dividend of $4.00 per share will be paid on December 1, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 11, 2026. The total amount of the special dividend will be approximately $14.2 million based on the current number of shares outstanding. Future dividends will be subject to Board approval. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.2 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. ​ On October 13, 2026, the Company also announced to its franchisee network the implementation of separate North American Ad Funds (“Ad Funds”) for its Once Upon A Child® and Play It Again Sports® brands. ​ Pursuant to the Company’s franchise agreements and system standards, franchisees operating Once Upon A Child and Play It Again Sports locations will be required to contribute an amount equal to 2% of sales to the applicable Ad Fund, commencing on January 31, 2027. As a result of this implementation, Once Upon A Child and Play It Again Sports franchisees will be required to spend 6% (up from 5%) of their sales on marketing, of which 2% will be contributed to the applicable Ad Fund. Contributions to the Ad Funds will be used to develop brand-specific creative and working media and to make marketing infrastructure improvements to increase brand visibility. If the Ad Funds had been in place during fiscal 2025, contributions to the Once Upon A Child and Play It Again Sports Ad Funds would have been approximately $10.9 million and $7.0 million, respectively. ​ ​ A portion of the Ad Funds’ proceeds will cover reasonable costs incurred by the Company in administering the Ad Funds, including investments in personnel or contractors and continued corporate investment in marketing activities. ​ The implementation of each Ad Fund is consistent with the Company’s existing franchise agreements, system standards, and franchise disclosure documents and does not amend the terms of any of the Company’s franchise agreements. ​ The Company anticipates that the primary impact on its financial statements from implementing the Ad Funds will be an increase in revenues and a corresponding increase in expenses. ​ ​ Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits ​ (d) Exhibits ​ c ​ ​ 99.1 ​ ​ ​ Third Quarter Results Press Release dated October 14, 2026 99.2 ​ ​ Quarterly Cash Dividend and Special Dividend Press Release dated October 14, 2026 104 ​ Cover Page Interactive Data File (embedded within the Inline XBRL Document and incorporated as Exhibit 101) ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ SIGNATURES ​ Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ co ​ ​ ​ WINMARK CORPORATION ​ ​ Date: October 14, 2026 By: /s/ Anthony D. For the nine months ended September 26, 2026, net income was $31,467,700 or $8.51 per share diluted compared to net income of $31,694,200 or $8.61 per share diluted for the same period last year. 2025 year-to-date results included $2.2 million of leasing income from the settlement of customer litigation. ​ “During the quarter, Winmark launched the North American Advertising Fund for Plato’s Closet and recently delivered a point-of-sale pilot at one of our franchised locations. Additionally, we have announced North American Advertising Funds for our Once Upon A Child and Play It Again Sports brands for campaigns starting in 2027,” stated Brett D. Heffes, Chair and Chief Executive Officer. “For many years Winmark and our franchisees have underinvested in the marketing necessary to consistently amplify our message across North America. We are taking the appropriate steps to expand awareness of our brands.” ​ Winmark - the Resale Company®, is a nationally recognized franchisor focused on sustainability and small business formation. We champion and guide entrepreneurs interested in operating one of our award winning resale franchises: Plato’s Closet®, Once Upon A Child®, Play It Again Sports®, Style Encore® and Music Go Round®. At September 26, 2026, there were 1,398 franchises in operation and over 2,800 available territories. An additional 79 franchises have been awarded but are not open. ​ This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the safe harbor provisions of Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), relating to future events or the future financial performance of the Company.
